title: What Became of the Slaves on a Georgia Plantation? Great Auction Sale of Slaves, at Savannah, Georgia, March 2d & 3d, 1859

It offers a poignant perspective on the inhumane practices of slavery and the deep bonds of family and community that were ruthlessly severed during such sales. Through poignant scenes and dialogues, Doesticks captures the anguish of families torn apart, the silent suffering of individuals waiting for their fate, and the often crude behavior of the buyers.
